description: List a semantic model's tables via DAX INFO.VIEW.TABLES() (the Analysis Services 'Schema Rowsets' exposed over the Power BI executeQueries endpoint). Returns readable model metadata WITHOUT fetching/parsing the TMDL/TMSL definition. Sibling commands: list-columns, list-measures, list-relationships.
notes: Keys are DAX-bracketed on the wire (`[Name]`, `[StorageMode]`); fabio strips the brackets for agent-friendly output. A model with no measures/relationships returns a clean `{"data":[],"count":0}`. Use `--query '[].{Name:Name,StorageMode:StorageMode}'` to project. Only the `INFO.VIEW.*` functions work over executeQueries — the raw `INFO.TABLES()`/`INFO.COLUMNS()` variants return HTTP 400.
